stemMd: A shop buys $n$ notebooks at $2 each and sells them all at $3.50 each. It also pays a one-time $12 delivery fee. Which expression gives its profit in dollars?
explanationMd: Revenue is 3.50n and total cost is 2n+12. Subtracting cost from revenue yields 1.50n−12.

distractorRationale.d: This adds purchase and sale prices instead of subtracting costs.
distractorRationale.c: This omits the notebooks' purchase cost.
distractorRationale.b: Delivery is a cost, not extra profit.
